go_model_policy.field_evidence: Each model field's canonical_case points into the Go parity manifest coverage table and its fresh producer/consumer corpus.
go_model_policy.modeling: Go uses concrete event structs and a generic Message/InputContent wire model rather than duplicating every Python and TypeScript schema alias.

shape_policy.accepted: A field is accepted when every present peer descriptor permits its requiredness, nullability, literal, and runtime kind.
shape_policy.aliases: Dart retains existing snake_case input aliases with camelCase key-presence precedence and emits canonical camelCase.
shape_policy.descriptor_paths: Each inventory field points into peer_shapes. Descriptor values are a recorded review snapshot bound to the exact pinned source bytes by SHA-256; executable extraction independently verifies model and field names only.
shape_policy.rejected: Missing required keys, invalid literals, and wrong non-null runtime kinds are rejected unless explicit_differences names the case.

source_extraction_policy.dart: Resolve relevant declarations through lib/ag_ui.dart and its exported barrels at the immutable implementation base.
source_extraction_policy.field_scope: Executable Python and TypeScript extraction verifies model/schema names, inheritance or extension, aliases, omissions, and field names. It does not reconstruct requiredness, nullability, literals, defaults, or runtime kinds.
source_extraction_policy.go: Resolve referenced exported declarations from the pinned Go event/type source set and validate canonical cases against the pinned Go corpus.
source_extraction_policy.python: Parse Pydantic model inheritance and compare the complete core __all__ public set with shared_exports.
source_extraction_policy.typescript: Resolve shared-export symbols through the package index.ts barrel; inferred z.infer aliases, Props helper types, error classes, and duplicate schema/type spellings are outside the one-row-per-logical-symbol inventory.

evidence_policy.canonical_aliases: Rows without a direct Go corpus pointer must resolve through canonical_evidence_aliases to a row with direct evidence.

intentional_omissions.ActivitySnapshotEvent.replace: Dart restores the default true but omits it from JSON when true.
intentional_omissions.ReasoningEncryptedValueEvent.rawEvent: Cipher-bearing events intentionally scrub rawEvent before JSON re-emission.

evidence_policy.requirement: Every implemented row must have one assertion-specific record derived from the manifest and executed by a model-family adapter; broad file or test-name fragments are insufficient.

explicit_differences.difference: Declared TypeScript/Go field; Python accepts it through permissive extra fields.
Existing Go int64 remains valid beyond 2^53-1; exact TypeScript roundtrip claims stop at 2^53-1.
Shared integral int64 domain; TypeScript-only fractional limits are excluded.
Go uses collision-free tuple grouping like Python; TypeScript joins labels with a space. Empty Go labels collapse to absent.
TypeScript-only helper, outside this shared parity plan.
Go collapses absent/empty maps; Go and Python accept outer null whereas TypeScript rejects it. Null values under keys remain meaningful.
encryptedContent, legacy request snake_case aliases and other Go-only extensions remain compatibility features, outside shared unknown-key roundtrip claims.
Go follows Python nonnegative safe-integer validation; TypeScript preserves negative, fractional and unsafe numeric counts. Per-language expectations record these excluded inputs.
Language-specific runtime APIs are outside Dart core model/JSON/SSE parity.
explicit_differences.scope: TypeScript agent, middleware, and reactive runtime APIs

explicit_differences.difference: No shared Dart transport implementation is in scope.
Dart-only deprecated event remains supported outside canonical counts.
Python and TypeScript require a non-null string; Dart retains the legacy String? base getter while concrete message constructors and decoders require an id.
Empty containers and debug map assertions remain; PR03 adds a separate canonical path.
Model toJson omits null forwardedProps; PR03 canonical HTTP codec emits the required key.
